profile.headline: Full Stack Web Developer | Writer/Artist | Always Learning
profile.summary: Full Stack Web Developer with a background in English and creative arts. Life-long learner with a Certificate in Full Stack Development from SMU. Creative problem-solver with recognized ability developing engaging and user-friendly applications. Detail-oriented problem solver with proven ability to creatively execute client visions.

positions.title: Teaching Assistant
positions.description: Supporting an intense certification program involving 250+ hours of in-class teaching through an extensive curriculum including HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, Java, jQuery, Node.js, Express.js, APIs, AJAX, Responsive Design, Heroku, Git, React, MySQL, and MongoDB.

positions.title: Central Grader (Full Stack Flex)
positions.description: Grading submitted certification program assignments by following a provided rubric to make sure all requirements are met and the application is fluid. Providing feedback along with words of encouragement. Reporting any struggling students to instructors so they can get better support.

projects.title: Replay
projects.description:
Website: https://replayvideos.herokuapp.com/
Replay is an application that allows its users to search for content using the Google Youtube API and add that content to individual playlists.
- HTML - CSS - JavaScript - ReactJS - Express - Express-session - Google Youtube API - Axios - Bcrypt - Dotenv - Mongoose - React Router -

projects.title: Gamer Groups
projects.description:
Website: https://gamer-groups.herokuapp.com/
This website is made to provide an easier way for users to find or make groups for playing games together.
- HTML - CSS - JavaScript - JQuery - Express - Express Handlebars - Bcrypt - Express Session - Dotenv - MySQL -
